claims.text: Catalytic durability of nanoscale PtPdRhRuIrOs solid-solution catalysts in ethanol oxidation is governed by local lattice distortions.
Local lattice distortions stabilize surface atoms against dissolution under reactive conditions.
Local lattice distortions stabilize the catalyst against surface restructuring under reactive conditions.
A controlled thermal treatment can partially reduce local lattice distortions without causing particle sintering or phase separation.
Reducing local lattice distortions will increase the rate of surface atomic rearrangement.
Reducing local lattice distortions will increase metal dissolution.
Increasing surface rearrangement and metal dissolution will decrease catalytic durability.
As-synthesized nanoscale PtPdRhRuIrOs catalysts have a high degree of local lattice strain and chemical disorder.
Local lattice distortions and chemical disorder modulate the binding energies of ethanol-oxidation intermediates.
Chemical disorder inhibits surface-atom dissolution.
High local lattice strain creates an energetically rugged catalyst surface.
An energetically rugged surface hinders atomic mobility and dissolution.
Annealing-induced strain relief makes the catalyst surface more homogeneous and more susceptible to oxidation.
Annealed catalysts will exhibit higher metal-dissolution rates than untreated catalysts during ethanol oxidation.
Annealed catalysts will exhibit faster electrochemical-performance decay than untreated catalysts during ethanol oxidation.
Annealing may change catalytic activity by altering adsorption characteristics of key reaction intermediates.
Untreated nanoscale PtPdRhRuIrOs catalysts have proven robust performance under ethanol-oxidation conditions.
The proposed relationship is limited to nanoscale PtPdRhRuIrOs solid solutions treated under conditions that avoid sintering and phase separation.
The proposed relationship may not apply to substantially different compositions, particle sizes, or processing histories.
Failure of verified strain reduction to produce a statistically significant durability loss relative to the untreated control would falsify the proposed mediation by lattice distortion.
